official.deadline_note: There is no central application deadline; each eligible university administers RTP scholarships and sets its own application rounds.
official.application_cycle: Ongoing programme; 2026 grant year allocations apply and stipend rates are indexed effective 1 January each year
official.status_note: RTP is an ongoing Australian Government programme delivered through universities; each university runs its own scholarship rounds.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Department guidelines require the university to award the PhD candidate an Australian Government RTP Fees Offset for the duration of their candidature by a participating university.
benefits: RTP Stipend: 2026 full-time base rate AUD 34,315 per year; full-time maximum rate AUD 53,608 per year (universities may pay any rate within the range)
Published 2027 rates: full-time base AUD 35,550 per year and full-time maximum AUD 55,537 per year
RTP Fees Offset covering tuition fees for the duration of candidature
Base and maximum stipend rates are indexed each year effective 1 January and announced by 1 October each year
eligibility: Enrolled or commencing an accredited research doctorate or research master's at an eligible Australian higher education provider
Universities administer RTP scholarships and award them competitively
Department program guidelines require an RTP Stipend (or equivalent, at a minimum equivalent to the RTP stipend base rate) for the duration of PhD candidature
requirements: Apply through the chosen university's postgraduate research process; RTP scholarships are administered by universities, not centrally
coverage: RTP Fees Offset toward tuition fees
application_method: Apply directly to a participating Australian university; no central application portal exists
official.application_route: Contact the postgraduate research office of your chosen university and apply within its own scholarship round.
official.study_mode: full-time or part-time (published support periods differ by load)
official.research_requirement: Candidature in an accredited research doctorate or research master's (higher degree by research) at an eligible university
official.duration: Minimum 3 years and up to a maximum of 4 years full-time (at the discretion of the higher education provider); minimum 6 years and up to a maximum of 8 years part-time
official.description: The Research Training Program is the Australian Government programme, delivered through research block grants, that funds higher degree by research students. RTP scholarships combine a stipend for living costs with a fees offset for tuition, are awarded by each eligible higher education provider, and are supported for a minimum of three and up to four years full-time (six to eight years part-time) for research doctorate students.

applicant_utility.summary: The RTP is Australia's government HDR scholarship: a stipend (2026 base AUD 34,315, up to AUD 53,608 per year full-time) plus a tuition fees offset, awarded by each university in its own competitive round. Because there is no central application, your real deadline is whatever your target university sets, often months before course start. Stipend rates are indexed each January and announced by 1 October, so rates quoted on third-party sites are frequently a year out of date.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Research-degree students (domestic and international) who can secure admission to an accredited research doctorate or research master's at a participating Australian university
application_readiness_checklist: Identify three to four universities whose RTP round dates differ, so one missed deadline does not end the cycle
Check each university's stipend level within the national range; two offers with identical prestige can differ by tens of thousands per year
Contact prospective supervisors before applying, as most RTP rounds require an agreed project
Prepare a research proposal, CV and transcripts to university standard rather than to a generic template
Confirm whether your target university bundles RTP with its own top-up scholarship, which some offer
common_rejection_risks: Applying after the university's internal deadline while assuming the degree application deadline applies
Weak alignment between the research proposal and the potential supervisor's funded projects
Missing that support durations differ: up to 4 years full-time for a doctorate, versus 6-8 years part-time
Relying on stale stipend figures quoted by aggregators instead of the current indexed rate
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The stipend (2026 base AUD 34,315 per year) covers general living costs and the fees offset covers tuition; no travel or relocation entitlement is published in the Department's material, so airfares, initial setup and dependants' costs remain with the student.
document_audit: There is no national document list; requirements are set per university, so read each university's RTP schedule rather than a generic checklist
If a university offer references an 'equivalent' scholarship, confirm in writing that the rate is at least the RTP base rate
alerts: Rates change annually: the page publishes 2027 rates (base AUD 35,550, maximum AUD 55,537) effective 1 January 2027
International students face university-level policy limits, so confirm your target university's position on overseas applicants before applying
RTP is administered entirely by universities; the Commonwealth does not run an application round you can enter directly
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for admission and the scholarship through each university's postgraduate research office in its own round; awards are decided internally with the stipend paid by the university.
